ANALYSIS AND SAVING
Resolve reliable cases runs missing analysis and reuses saved OCR and artwork evidence for the same photo. There is no need to analyse all photos first. Reanalysing one photo forces a new reading and remains an exceptional retry. Resolution covers pending photos in the library, not just the visible filter.

OCR ORIGIN
Artwork can propose the correct printing and set, updating its image and price. Automatic saving requires OCR and artwork to agree on identity, artwork confidence and margin thresholds (0.70 and 0.08), and a compatible language.

EDSCAN ORIGIN
The printing and set identified by EdScan are retained. OCR checks identity and determines language without requiring artwork recognition again. With corroborated identity, a printing available only in EN is confirmed as EN if there is no contradictory evidence; for example, Zombie Master from LEB. If OCR detects Italian but that printing only supports EN, it remains a conflict for manual review: EN is not forced and the set is not changed automatically.

LIMITS AND MANUAL REVIEW
Identity disagreement, ambiguous or incompatible language, weak artwork evidence, incomplete catalogues and multiple copies or photos of one row require review. Finish is not inferred from the image. Pending manual edits are excluded from automatic resolution; quantities and groups are preserved. Every batch keeps a prior backup and history. Physical condition and a selling price are not guaranteed.
